findings: All three distal-grip variants avoid the detached upper-shaft spots seen in the first two rounds.
F2 retains readable front and side bristle width and reaches farther across the non-holding foot than F1. F3 turns the fan back toward the holding side.
The shaft is held near its rounded end; the short upper segment stays in the distal hand region. The grip is no longer centered on a broad forearm region.
The72pilot images show no visible isolated shaft patch or penetrated fan. Exact seven-pose vertex-parity candidates pass; triangle surface intersections and continuous motion remain required.
limits: Vertex checks alone do not prove surface clearance.
Top/back occlusion by the original character is expected and is not a shape transformation.
